resources.string: Detected: %1$s · allow notification access once and values start arriving automatically.
SokeriPilot reads new values from %1$s automatically. No setup inside that app is needed.
No CGM app found yet. Install your sensor\'s app, or connect Nightscout.
Notification access is on. Every new CGM notification updates the car screen.
One-time permission: Android only lets an app read another app\'s data through notification access. After granting it, values arrive automatically — no per-app setup, nothing leaves the phone.
Start automatically when Android Auto connects
Monitoring starts when the phone is projected into your head unit and stops when the connection ends; nothing runs in the background otherwise.
The key is not stored on the device; only the SHA-1 digest required by Nightscout is kept.
Open SokeriPilot on your phone and allow notification access so values can be read from your CGM app.
The last reading is stale. Check the sensor and connection.
Car notifications are off: open SokeriPilot on your phone and grant notification permission. Until then, glucose is only visible on this screen.
Driving mode is off: open SokeriPilot on your phone and turn on Driving mode so the notification appears while navigation or music is open.
No CGM source: open SokeriPilot on your phone and allow notification access (one tap), or connect Nightscout.
The driving monitor service could not start. Reopen SokeriPilot on your phone; if the problem persists, exclude the app from battery optimization.
Silent current glucose status while navigation or music is open
No new reading for 15 minutes. Check the sensor and the CGM app on your phone.
Changing a sensor? This pauses the “No glucose data” reminder for two hours, so a warm-up does not interrupt a drive. The cockpit keeps showing how old the last value is.
Sensor change · %1$d min of quiet left. You can resume the reminder at any time.
Show glucose while navigation or music is open

Android Auto does not allow other apps to keep a persistent window on top. SokeriPilot uses a car notification instead: the value updates with every reading, a short alert appears when out of range, and one tap opens the cockpit.
Allow notification access for your CGM app first, or connect Nightscout.
The driving monitor could not start. Battery optimization or a system restriction may be blocking it; reopen the app.
Monitoring starts when you connect the phone to Android Auto.
SokeriPilot is looking at every CGM notification. The last %1$d are listed below, newest first.
Notification access is off, so SokeriPilot cannot see your CGM app yet. Allow it above.
No CGM notification seen yet. Wait for your sensor app\'s next update; it should appear here within a minute. If it never does, the sensor app is not posting a value in its notification.
SokeriPilot is not a medical device. It does not recommend treatment or insulin doses. Alerts are advisory; always rely on your sensor\'s official app and your healthcare professional\'s guidance.
Thresholds are invalid. Low must be between 55 and 120, high between 120 and 300 mg/dL, and low must be below high.
%1$d%% left on the sensor. It may stop sending soon.
Warn me before a low or high at this rate

Health Connect permission was not granted.
